title: Madrid: Prado Museum Guided Tour with Skip-the-Line Ticket
start: Plaza de Cánovas del Castillo (Neptune fountain)
summary: Skip-the-line Prado ticket and a 90-minute tour with a professional guide, in English or Spanish.

title: Madrid: Royal Palace Expert Guided Tour with Skip-the-Line
start: Opera metro station, Plaza de Isabel II
summary: Entry to the Royal Palace and its gardens, a professional guide and headphones; the walk in goes through Plaza de Oriente.

title: Madrid: Royal Palace Skip-the-Line Guided Tour
summary: Guided walk from Calle Mayor past Plaza Mayor, San Miguel market and Plaza de la Villa, then a skip-the-line tour of the Royal Palace with headsets.

title: Madrid: Tapas & Wine Tasting Tour with Local Guide
summary: Four century-old bars in the Literary Quarter, 12 traditional tapas and one drink per bar, with a bilingual local guide.

title: Madrid: Segovia and Toledo Tour, Alcazar, and Cathedral
summary: Air-conditioned coach to Segovia and Toledo with entry to the Alcázar of Segovia and, if the option is selected, a guided visit to Toledo Cathedral.
